en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear: sounds like a modern town song, no author named. The saat (clock tower) is Prilep's well-known landmark.

lines.cyr: Песна сакам тебе да ти пеам,
lines.lat: Pesna sakam tebe da ti peam,
lines.en: I want to sing a song to you,

lines.cyr: да ти пеам и да заиграм.
lines.lat: da ti peam i da zaigram.
lines.en: to sing to you and start dancing.

lines.cyr: На младоста моја да се сетам,
lines.lat: Na mladosta moja da se setam,
lines.en: To remember my youth,
to remember and tremble.

lines.cyr: Како чука саатот да го слушнам,
lines.lat: Kako čuka saatot da go slušnam,
lines.en: To hear the clock tower strike,

lines.cyr: да го слушнам, па да воздивнам.
lines.lat: da go slušnam, pa da vozdivnam.
lines.en: to hear it and sigh.
To stroll through the old bazaar,
to drink my fill in the tavern.
Prilep, town, you are the dearest,
you keep my memories,
may your radiance be eternal,
Prilep, my native land.

lines.cyr: Само едно срце в' гради имам,
lines.lat: Samo edno srce v' gradi imam,
lines.en: I have only one heart in my chest,
I give it to you, town.

lines.cyr: Сонце тебе вечно да те грее,
lines.lat: Sonce tebe večno da te gree,
lines.en: May the sun warm you forever,
may the southern wind caress you.

lines.cyr: Тешко ми е збогум да ти речам,
lines.lat: Teško mi e zbogum da ti rečam,
lines.en: It is hard for me to say goodbye to you,

lines.cyr: да ти речам, да не заплачам.
lines.lat: da ti rečam, da ne zaplačam.
lines.en: to say it without crying.

lines.cyr: Солзи сами по лице ми течат,
lines.lat: Solzi sami po lice mi tečat,
lines.en: Tears flow down my face by themselves,
they flow and do not stop.
Prilep, town, you are the dearest,
you keep my memories,
may your radiance be eternal,
Prilep, my native land.
